archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL GAMER CYBERNETIC

entry_surfaces./: tactical gaming landing hero with glowing cybernetic HUD visual, feature bento grid, and direct CTA to /app
entry_surfaces./app: command center layout with tactical left sidebar, telemetry header, SVG optimization dial, quick RIP actions, game profile cards, tweak manager tabs, and hardware specs drawer
entry_surfaces./login: tactical obsidian auth card with cyan neon accents, positioning pitch on left, instant guest access bypass button, and email login option

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 on all text surfaces
accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: respect motion query for HUD sweeps and gauge spins
accessibility.data_testids: required on all tabs, toggles, buttons, gauges, and game preset cards

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Backend: Remove mandatory local MongoDB connection failure. Use robust JSON-file fallback storage in backend/lib/db.py and server.py so the server boots instantly with 0ms delay without Mongo.
2. Routing: Ensure http://localhost:3000/app loads instantly without login wall or stuck loader, auto-creating/attaching a local guest session if none exists.
3. Keep the full tactical gamer visual identity: Dark obsidian (#090A0F) background, neon cyan (#00F0FF) telemetry highlights, Sora headings, DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono gauges.

4. All operational dashboard modules must be fully interactive: Telemetry gauges, SVG optimization ring, RIP Mode countdown modal, Restore Points, Game preset cards (Fortnite, Valorant, CS2, Warzone, Roblox, Minecraft), 50-tweak catalog with category filters, Benchmark simulator, Action history restore, and Hardware detection.
5. Maintain clean project structure prepared for future Supabase DB and Clerk auth integration.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_tone: Tactical cybernetic command-center for high-performance PC optimization (pt-BR locale)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_emojis: Use lucide-react tactical icons (Activity, Zap, Shield, Cpu, Gauge, Terminal, Flame, RefreshCw, Crosshair), never 🤖 or 💡
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.glass_and_glow: Use 1px borders with border-[#1E293B] and hover:border-[#00F0FF]/40 with cyan subtle drop-shadows
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids: Include descriptive data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='sidebar-nav-jogos', data-testid='toggle-tweak-gpu-boost', data-testid='rip-mode-trigger-button')
